opportunities.point: MSTC maintains a general aspiration to achieve double-digit growth.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Look, I am basically a very conservative kind of person. So I would always say that double-digit growth aspiration is what we always have." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Management targets annual growth rates between 10% and 20%.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So between 10% to 20%. So that is something that we would always aspire to..." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: MSTC obtained in-principle approval from the Reserve Bank of India to establish a TReDS platform.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "I am happy to inform you that the in-principle approval has been received from the Reserve Bank of India the day before yesterday, of course subject to fulfilling certain conditions and audits." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: MSTC is expanding its B2B travel portal by adding corporate clients.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So apart from the B2B travel portal, for which we are adding corporate clients now and in the process of steady expansion and stabilization." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.
The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 5.89% earnings growth vs 14% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: A services tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Iron ore auction volumes through MSTC platforms increased significantly during the quarter.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Similarly, iron ore volumes have increased significantly." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: MSTC platform facilitated the sale of nearly 4 lakh metric tons of chromite and 1.54 million metric tons of iron ore/coal in Q2.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Apart from nearly 4 lakh metric tons of chromite and 1.54 million metric tons of Iron ore/Coal has also been sold through MSTC platform during this quarter." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Gross merchandise value transacted across MSTC portals reached INR 545.80 billion in H1, excluding trading.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "During the H1, the total gross merchandise value that has passed through our portal is INR545.80 billion, and basically it is excluding the trading business this we have, MSTC has finally exited as promised earlier also that it will go to the very risk-free..." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: MSTC conducted liquor license auctions for Karnataka, generating approximately INR 125 crores for the state.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So during the quarter, liquor license auctions were held for the Government of Karnataka, resulting in revenue of approximately INR125 crores for the state." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 218 -> 262 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 260 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -28 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
Future operationalization of dedicated coal exchanges may cause trading volumes to migrate away from MSTC's auction platform.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So naturally, if there is an exchange, and at some point of time, maybe 3 or 4 or 5 years down the line, the entire trading volume would then be regulated by way of regulation, be done from the exchange." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: MSTC's new TReDS platform will need to share market volume with four existing operational platforms.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So naturally, the business will obviously have to be shared with these other platforms also." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: The scrap business is cyclical, which can impact revenue growth.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "But scrap has always been a cyclical thing. The steel sector as such is very cyclical. So, the rates keep going up and down." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Jun) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S31/W24/O29/T20), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 73 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
